standard: landed-regions-standard-1018: local region trees, every cross-region net LANDED, per-region child-flop gate (TT and FF <= 80 ps); 1-bit reset runs are the only plain cross-region hops
window: (2 - 4) T + t_hold < dL < 2 T - t_cq - t_setup at TT and FF

loose_status.note: sticky status flags (no reservation / valid / payload effect): landed, outside the offset solve; the reader sees each flag lag_edges later than the flat parent

same_depth_forest.scope: Source leaf allocation only. Scalar child internals, actual parameter binding, native reset phase/reach and all clock entries remain unqualified.

reset.note: flat reference == landed parent with its reset delayed by depth; child c's reset run is depth + t(c)

compiler.note: every latency change vs the flat parent; the compiler schedule takes these (static calendar, no runtime flow control)

die_obligations: drop one clock per region at the region's clock port (ck_<r>); each region builds its own local tree
communicating regions (landed pairs) need NO phase alignment inside the landing window at TT and FF
reset-hop pairs ['core-hr']: region skew within about +/-400 ps at TT and FF (1-bit single-cycle hops)
boundary ports are timed against the region in port_regions / the record; die links into them land on THAT clock

ctlm7_derived.why: CTLM7 10-20: the bounded native32 netlist (ctlm6_bound_macro) renames every cell u_<n>, so the L5 landing multicycles (get_cells u_lpl_<n>_w/_r) cannot bind; this copy only renames top to the netlist module and selects the lp.py landing_mcp-false SDC mode (every ring->read cone single-cycle full STA: tightening only, nothing relaxed). Regions, D/E/K, landings and reset runs are the lp6 record unchanged.

ctlm8_derived.change: cf leaves a pin register in u_go (CTLM8 checklist 1): compiler out-port offset cf 6 -> 7 (+1 edge, priced); every other offset unchanged; bench tb_np8 compares cf at +7
